# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Main    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within **halal-player**, please report it responsibly.

- **Email**: ahmedfawzyjr@gmail.com
- **Response Time**: Initial acknowledgment within 48 hours.

Please do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.
